title: Kobra Systems
brief: Polished React components and micro-interactions (OTP inputs, AI editor, streaming text) — from the shared UI-libraries list.
details: Kobra Systems is a React component library and micro-interaction collection built with React and Tailwind, offering dozens of free polished components plus a paid Pro tier. Each component is copy-paste ready with three files (the .tsx component, styles.css, and a prompt.md for AI-assisted customization) and live demos showing every state — inputs and form controls, OTP inputs, carousels, toasts, chat interfaces, tables, charts, navigation, overlays, and animated micro-interactions like magnetic buttons, halftone dots, and shimmer effects. Light and dark themes are designed per component, with examples built on input-otp and Motion.
